name: hud_stack_ready_in_a_wave
description: In a wave of High Water the horn calls the next wave (M8, design 2.7 and 5.7, contract-m8 §9): the Ready slot stays live during wave 6, its cost is what a call pays now and its tooltip says 'Call wave 7 now: +10 for the window, +N for the lives on the road' with the wave's checks and that it sets out at once among the creeps on the road; the first press of D only asks 'Call wave 7 now? Press again' for two seconds and sends nothing, a second press after those two seconds asks again, and a second press within them sends the call; Space and N are the horn too. Alone the stacked horn sounds as the call lands, nothing waiting on the strip: the strip says 'Waves 6–7/12', counts every wave's creeps, shows wave 7's checks, and the waves to come start at wave 6 with both marked now. A call in that wave brings wave 8 too: 'Waves 6–8/12', all three marked now.

steps.assert: Game.stacks() and Game.can_stack() and not node('Ready').disabled and scene.hud.card()[5]['state'] == 'ok'
steps.msg: in a wave of High Water the horn is live: a call for the next wave would be taken
its cost is what a call pays now: the window it skips and the stake

steps.assert: node('Tooltip').visible and tip.begins_with('Call wave 7 now: +10 for the window, +%d for the lives on the road.' % pay[1]) and tip.contains('It brings ') and tip.contains('It sets out at once, among the creeps on the road.') and not tip.contains('behind') and tip.contains('Press twice')
steps.msg: the tooltip names the wave it would call, its checks, what it would pay now, and that it sets out at once

steps.assert: scene.controller.call_armed() and node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'Call wave 7 now? Press again'
steps.msg: the first press only asks for a second
after two seconds the question lapses
a press after those two seconds is a first press again

steps.assert: not scene.controller.call_armed() and not Game.is_ready() and not scene.controller.wants_ready()
steps.msg: the second press within them sends the call (Space is the horn too), and alone its horn sounds as it lands: the Ready it said is cleared

steps.assert: node('Countdown').text == '· %d creeps left' % Game.creeps_left() and Game.creeps_left() > Game.spawns_left() and Game.spawns_left() > 0
steps.msg: the creeps left count every wave's, walking and still to come, and nothing waits on the strip
and the strip's glyphs are the newest wave's
the waves to come start at the older wave on the road
both marked now (the next ends on its last creep's numbers: no text there)
a call in that wave brings wave 8: three on the road, 'Waves 6–8/12'
